description: Adapts already corrected OpenXR angular velocity to Steam Link 2.0.23's local controller axes. Requires the active Galaxy XR OpenXR Velocity Frame runtime module; do not use with stock runtime velocities or old HAL/velocity/extrapolation APK layers. Changes angular velocity only, not poses, linear velocity or prediction. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset A/B validation pending. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller angular world to local

description: Routes controller vibration to the grip vibrator instead of the trigger, which Galaxy XR uses for every OpenXR vibration. The grip one needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without it vibration is stock. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku

description: Makes the Galaxy XR runtime extrapolate controller poses to the time VRLink asks, instead of repeating one sample per display frame, and filters jitter out of the streamed pose. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code changes. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller pose extrapolation

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the grip pose. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space. Controller tracking and haptics based on @4uva4ek's Galaxy XR modules: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
name: Controller velocity frame
